exceptions.subject: ubuntu-24.04
exceptions.risk_reason: GitHub-hosted runner images are not exposed as digest-addressable artifacts; the fixed OS label still receives image updates.
exceptions.mitigation: The OS family is fixed, every external action and OCI image is digest-bound, Node is exact, and release jobs fail closed on their required tool versions. Reviewed image 20260907.300.1 on 2026-09-11 (OS 24.04.5 LTS, kernel 6.17.0-1022-azure).

exceptions.subject: windows-2025

exceptions.mitigation: The OS family is fixed, checkout and Node setup are commit-pinned, Node is exact, and this job has no remote package installation. Reviewed image 20260907.229.1 on 2026-09-11 (OS 10.0.26100 Build 33296).
